messages:
Priya (security): Alert: several services in eu-west-1 reporting KMS AccessDenied during cert unwrap after RBAC change rolled this morning. Observed increased 502s.
Marta (eng-infra): can you paste the failing log line and which principal is denied?
Evan (oncall): log:
```
2026-03-23T09:12:05Z proxy-54 ERROR cert_unwrap: KMSAccessDenied arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:222222:key/aa11-bb22
principal=arn:aws:sts::222222:assumed-role/svc-proxy-eu/session-7 req=cid-77ab
```
Marta (eng-infra): looks like the delegated assume-role lost kms:Decrypt via the key policy after PR 4410 tightened iam:AssumeRole. Short fix: add a time-limited key-policy statement granting kms:Decrypt to the assumed-role arn or revert the PR.
Jules (sre): while we patch, increase CERT_CACHE_TTL to 600s and enable soft-fail path so traffic doesn't error hard. I'll push a helm patch.
Priya (security): if we add a temporary grant, add incident_id=inc-20260323-eu-kms to logs and require terraform change with explicit expiration. Compliance needs an audit entry.
kms-bot: Emergency key policy override applied (1h). Audit entry created.
deploy-bot: rollout proxy-eu v3.0.1 -> v3.0.2 started; 4/4 updated.
Evan (oncall): after override and restart, decrypt success returned to baseline. No further 502s in last 10m.
Priya (security): follow-ups: 1) update key policy to allow `kms:ViaService` + region condition for delegated roles 2) rework PR 4410 to reintroduce scoped delegation for svc-proxy 3) add keystore decrypt failure alert >5% over 5m 4) enrich cert-fetch logs with assumed_role_arn, kms_key_id, request_id.
Marta (eng-infra): opening RCA ticket INC-6340 and PR drafts for key policy and RBAC reconciliation. Will include IAM diffs and audit samples.
Jules (sre): scheduling incident review and postmortem. Monitoring for 24h.
Priya (security): thanks team. If anyone sees new anomalies tag with inc-20260323-eu-kms and ping @here.
